fn ov_init(stage:*OvStage, context:*RmdContext, abi:*u8, hooks:*OvHooks)->unit {
    (*stage).context = context;
    (*stage).abi = abi;
    (*stage).hooks = hooks;
    (*stage).globals = make RmdMap { entries:null(*RmdMapEntry), count:0usize, capacity:0usize };
    (*stage).declarations = (*stage).globals;
    (*stage).type_keys = (*stage).globals;
    (*stage).first_global = null(*OvGlobal);
    (*stage).first_function = null(*OvFunction);
    (*stage).scratch = make OvText { data:null(*u8), size:0usize, capacity:0usize };
    (*stage).failed = false;
}

fn ov_error(stage:*OvStage, loc:*RmdLoc, message:*u8)->unit {
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    (*stage).failed = true;
    rmd_set_error((*stage).context, (*loc).source, (*loc).offset, message);
}

fn ov_alloc(stage:*OvStage, size:usize, alignment:usize)->*u8 {
    if (*stage).failed || size == 0usize { return null(*u8); }
    var result:*u8 = rmd_try_alloc((*stage).context, size, alignment);
    if result == null(*u8) { (*stage).failed = true; }
    return result;
}

fn ov_put(stage:*OvStage, map:*RmdMap, key:usize, value:*u8)->unit {
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    if !rmd_try_map_set((*stage).context, map, key, value) { (*stage).failed = true; }
}

fn ov_intern(stage:*OvStage, bytes:*u8, size:usize)->*RmdName {
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdName); }
    var name:*RmdName = rmd_try_intern((*stage).context, bytes, size);
    if name == null(*RmdName) { (*stage).failed = true; }
    return name;
}

fn ov_bytes(stage:*OvStage, buffer:*OvText, bytes:*u8, size:usize)->unit {
    if (*stage).failed || size == 0usize { return; }
    if size > 9223372036854775807usize - (*buffer).size {
        var loc:RmdLoc = make RmdLoc { source:null(*RmdSource), offset:0usize };
        ov_error(stage, &loc, "overload signature size exceeds target limit");
        return;
    }
    var needed:usize = (*buffer).size + size;
    if needed > (*buffer).capacity {
        var capacity:usize = (*buffer).capacity;
        if capacity == 0usize { capacity = 128usize; }
        while capacity < needed {
            if capacity > 9223372036854775807usize / 2usize { capacity = needed; }
            else { capacity = capacity * 2usize; }
        }
        var data:*u8 = ov_alloc(stage, capacity, 1usize);
        if data == null(*u8) { return; }
        rmd0_host_move_bytes(data, (*buffer).data, (*buffer).size);
        (*buffer).data = data;
        (*buffer).capacity = capacity;
    }
    rmd0_host_move_bytes((*buffer).data + (*buffer).size as isize, bytes, size);
    (*buffer).size = needed;
}

fn ov_text(stage:*OvStage, buffer:*OvText, text:*u8)->unit {
    ov_bytes(stage, buffer, text, c_length(text));
}

fn ov_number(stage:*OvStage, buffer:*OvText, value:u64)->unit {
    var digits:[u8;20] = uninit;
    var index:usize = 20usize;
    while true {
        index = index - 1usize;
        digits[index] = (value % 10u64) as u8 + 48u8;
        value = value / 10u64;
        if value == 0u64 { break; }
    }
    ov_bytes(stage, buffer, &digits[index], 20usize - index);
    ov_text(stage, buffer, "_");
}

fn ov_part(stage:*OvStage, buffer:*OvText, bytes:*u8, size:usize)->unit {
    ov_number(stage, buffer, size as u64);
    ov_bytes(stage, buffer, bytes, size);
}

fn ov_type(stage:*OvStage, kind:u32, loc:*RmdLoc)->*RmdTypeSyntax {
    var syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax = ov_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdTypeSyntax), alignof(RmdTypeSyntax)) as *RmdTypeSyntax;
    if syntax != null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { (*syntax).kind = kind; (*syntax).loc = *loc; }
    return syntax;
}

fn ov_global(stage:*OvStage, name:*RmdName)->*OvGlobal {
    return rmd_map_get(&(*stage).globals, name as usize) as *OvGlobal;
}
